findings.message: Entry param page (filter:despesasPendentes, persisted) has no state in the definition. Added public state `page` (number | null, persisted) recording the page chosen with a pager; listarDespesasPendentesEquipe(page, append) uses it and publishes it when not appending.

Param despesaId selects analiseDespesa but no member selects. Added selectDespesa(id | null), which publishes selectedDespesa (id) and fetches the record into `despesa` through obterDespesaParaAnalise.
rejeitarDespesa needs a typed reason but the definition has no <command>.input state. Added rejeitarDespesaDraft (RejeitarDespesaDraft) with setRejeitarDespesaDraft.

aprovarDespesa and rejeitarDespesa return `despesa`, which no state declares as target. Applied it to the `despesa` state and removed the decided row from `despesas` (queue shows only awaitingApproval); no reload.
public page is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
